This section will look at New York as a case study city, with their the [OneNYC 2050](https://www.nyc.gov/site/cpp/our-programs/onenyc.page) strategy's goal to achieve "A Liveable Climate". Like most dense urban areas, New York City (NYC) is also facing the problems of warmer urban temperatures than its rural and suburban neighborhoods. Given growing events of higher frequency, longer lasting and more intense heat waves, this section will focus on one of NYC's experiencing climate threats of [Extreme Heat](https://www.nyc.gov/content/climate/pages/extreme-heat).

## Summary

The OneNYC 2050 is a long term strategic plan comprimised of 8 goals and 30 initiatives. It aims to achieve an equitable, sustainable and thriving city through addressing its climate change, economic equality, housing, health, education, transportation and infrastructure.

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **A Livable Climate, OneNYC 2050**                                                                                |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 20. Achieve carbon neutrality and 100 percent clean electricity                                                   |
| 21. A LIVABLE CLIMATE Strengthen communities, buildings, infrastructure, and the waterfront to be more resilient  |
| 22. Create economic opportunities for all New Yorkers through climate action                                      |
| 23. Fight for climate accountability and justice                                                                  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

NYC has identified extreme heat and urban heat island effects (UHI) to be one of its major climate threats to be solved through its long-term strategic plan.

Heat Vulnerability Index to show neighbourhoods that are more at risk following extreme heat
